scripts.text:
[Alreg]
Me like meat, muheh.
You! Look tempting.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾雷格]
我喜歡吃肉，嘿嘿。
你！看起來真誘人。

scripts.text:
[Alreg]
Me want to taste you.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾雷格]
我想嚐嚐你的味道。

scripts.text: ^FF3355*Crunch* Crunch*^000000

[{0}]
NooOOoOOoOoO~!

[Alreg]
It long time since I had meat
so... so good. You taste
good. Alreg give you this
for payback. Present!
*Burrrp*
scripts.translation:
[阿爾雷格]
好久沒吃到這麼好吃的肉了...味道真不錯。
阿爾雷格給你這個作為補償。禮物！
*嗝~*

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ow~! What are you
trying to do, kill me?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
痛~！你想幹嘛，想殺了我嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Alreg]
Hm? Oh, no no no.
Me am trying to eat you.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾雷格]
嗯？哦，不不不。
我只是想把你吃掉。

scripts.text:
[Crayu]
Living one...
Listen to this song...
It's been sung by many for a
long time, but nobody knows
when it was made or who wrote it.
scripts.translation:
[克拉尤]
活人...
聽聽這首歌...
它被許多人傳唱了很久，但沒人知道它是何時創作的，也不知道是誰寫的。

scripts.text:
[Crayu]
^FF00001. Mountain sunset to the west
^FF00002. Where the purple dusk falls 
^FF00003. Surrounded by beautiful melody
^FF00004. You become the key that ignores its master^000000
scripts.translation:
[克拉尤]
^FF00001. 西邊的山日落
^FF00002. 紫色黃昏降臨之處
^FF00003. 被美妙的旋律環繞
^FF00004. 你成為了無視主人的鑰匙^000000

scripts.text:
[Crayu]
Okay, wait! Here's a test for you!
scripts.translation:
[克拉尤]
好了，等等！這裡有個測試給你！

scripts.text:
[Crayu]
Okay, wait! Here's a test for you!
Write down the first line of the song.
scripts.translation:
[克拉尤]
好了，等等！這裡有個測試給你！
寫下這首歌的第一句。

scripts.text:
[Crayu]
Okay, wait! Here's a test for you!
Write down the second line of the song.
scripts.translation:
[克拉尤]
好了，等等！這裡有個測試給你！
寫下這首歌的第二句。

scripts.text:
[Crayu]
Okay, wait! Here's a test for you!
Write down the third line of the song.
scripts.translation:
[克拉尤]
好了，等等！這裡有個測試給你！
寫下這首歌的第三句。

scripts.text:
[Crayu]
Okay, wait! Here's a test for you!
Write down the fourth line of the song.
scripts.translation:
[克拉尤]
好了，等等！這裡有個測試給你！
寫下這首歌的第四句。

scripts.text:
[Crayu]
Excellent...!
So you've been listening~!
That makes you one of my
favorite guests. Here's a
little reward for you.
scripts.translation:
[克拉尤]
很好...！
看來你一直在聽~！
那你就是我喜歡的客人之一。這是給你的小小獎勵。

scripts.text:
[Crayu]
Lastly, I hope you will show your
respect to other Bards, just as
you have done for me.
scripts.translation:
[克拉尤]
最後，我希望你能像對我一樣，對其他詩人也保持尊重。

scripts.text:
[Crayu]
*Sigh*... If you had only
listened to me, it would
have been easy to answer.
Try to remember the line
and try again!
scripts.translation:
[克拉尤]
*嘆氣*...如果你剛才認真聽我的話，回答就會很容易。
試著記住歌詞，再試一次！

scripts.text:
[Crayu]
I wonder what the lyrics mean...
They seem quite profound...
I have the feeling that this song
carries some secret.
scripts.translation:
[克拉尤]
我在想這些歌詞是什麼意思...
它們似乎很有深意...
我覺得這首歌裡藏著某種秘密。

scripts.text:
[Kuzkahina]
I don't understand
why I can't make any
money with this store...
Even when I was alive
I could never make any
money with my businesses...
scripts.translation:
[庫茲卡希娜]
我不明白為什麼這家店賺不到錢...
即使我活著的時候，做生意也從來沒賺到過錢...

scripts.text:
[Kuzkahina]
Hey you! Make yourself useful
and throw this away when you leave.
scripts.translation:
[庫茲卡希娜]
嘿，你！別閒著，離開的時候把這個扔掉。

scripts.text:
[Kuzkahina]
Gosh, what's with this store?
How did I end up hiring such useless employees...?
*mumble mumble*
*mumble mumble*
scripts.translation:
[庫茲卡希娜]
天哪，這家店到底怎麼回事？
我怎麼會僱到這麼沒用的員工...
*嘟囔嘟囔*
*嘟囔嘟囔*

scripts.text:
[Kuzkahina]
I don't understand
why I can't make any
money with this store...
Even when I was alive
I could never make any
money with my businesses...
scripts.translation:
[庫茲卡希娜]
我不明白為什麼這家店賺不到錢...
即使我活著的時候，做生意也從來沒賺到過錢...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou found something
half-buried near a grave.
It looks very well-shaped.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你在墳墓附近發現了一個半埋在土裡的東西。
它的形狀看起來非常規整。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFWould you like to pick it up?^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你要把它撿起來嗎？^000000

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou found something
half-buried near a grave.
It looks very well-shaped.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你在墳墓附近發現了一個半埋在土裡的東西。
它的形狀看起來非常規整。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFWould you like to pick it up?^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你要把它撿起來嗎？^000000

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou see a big, heavy piano.
You get the feeling that
its music would sound magnificient.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你看到一架又大又重的鋼琴。
你感覺它演奏出的音樂一定非常美妙。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs you examine the piano,
you find that 7 keys
are missing in the
middle of the keyboard.
If you had all the keys,
you could play music...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF當你檢查鋼琴時，
你發現琴鍵中間有7個鍵缺失了。
如果你集齊所有的鍵，
就能演奏音樂了...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou took the keys you've found
and inserted them into
each empty space.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你拿起找到的琴鍵，
將它們插入每一個空缺的位置。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFBut then you realize
that you're missing the last
key for the space on the far
left of the keyboard...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF但隨後你意識到，
琴鍵最左側的位置還缺最後一個鍵...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs you bend towards
the final empty key space
to take a better look at it...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF當你彎下腰，
湊近最後一個空缺的位置仔細檢視時...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou begin to feel dizzy and
your body feels as if it were
floating in air. Then, your
vision starts to blur...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你開始感到頭暈，
身體彷彿漂浮在空中。接著，
你的視線開始模糊...^000000

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Huh? ...You're alive, aren't you?
I'm not sure how more of you are
able to get here and I don't
know your reasons for coming,
but this place is dangerous for
the living.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
咦？...你還活著，是嗎？
我不明白為什麼還有更多活人能來到這裡，
我也不知道你們來的原因，
但對活人來說，這裡很危險。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
I am sending you back
outside of this town.
If you can help it, you
better not come back to
this place.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
我要把你送回這個城鎮外面。
如果可以的話，
你最好不要再來這裡。

scripts.text:
[Erious]
I wish you safety from harm
in your journeys, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
願你在旅途中平安無事，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Erious]
*Sob*Sob*
*Cries* Wahhh...!
Elly, how could you
leave me this way...
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
*抽泣*抽泣*
*哭泣* 哇啊啊...!
艾莉，你怎麼能這樣丟下我...

scripts.text: Comfort him.
scripts.translation: 安慰他

scripts.text: Neglect him.
scripts.translation: 無視他

scripts.text:
[Erious]
Ah, thank you for your kindness.
*Sob* My wife died while I was on
a trip. I'm so sorry that I
couldn't be with her when
the end came...
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
啊，謝謝你的善意。
*抽泣* 我妻子在我出差期間去世了。我很抱歉，
在她臨終時我沒能陪在她身邊...

scripts.text:
[Erious]
I wish I could talk to my Elly,
although I know it's too late now.
*Cries* But... there is one last
hope that I have. My absolute
final chance...
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
我真希望能和我的艾莉說說話，
雖然我知道現在為時已晚。
*哭泣* 但是...我還有最後一絲希望。
這是我最後的希望...

scripts.text:
[Erious]
I was told that somewhere
in this world, there exists a town
where the dead reside. I might be
able to meet my wife there, but
I cannot leave my children here
without me. *Cries*
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
我聽說這個世界上有一個城鎮，
那裡住著亡者。也許我能在那裡見到我的妻子，
但我不能把孩子們留在這裡沒有我。*哭泣*

scripts.text: I can deliver your message to her.
scripts.translation: 我可以把你的話轉達給她

scripts.text: I am so sorry to hear that.
scripts.translation: 聽到這個訊息我很遺憾

scripts.text:
[Erious]
Oh, can you?
Thank you so much for your
generosity. If you can do
this for me, I would be
greatly indebted to you.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
哦，你可以嗎？
非常感謝你的慷慨。如果你能幫我做這件事，
我將感激不盡。

scripts.text:
[Erious]
You're an adventurer, aren't you?
If your journeys take you to that
town of the dead, and if you
happen to meet her by chance...
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
你是一名冒險者，對吧？
如果你的旅途會經過那座亡者之鎮，
並且你恰好能遇到她...

scripts.text:
[Erious]
Please send Elly a message for me,
let her know that what happened
a month ago was all my fault.
Thank you for your help,
and please take care.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
請替我帶個話給艾莉，
告訴她一個月前發生的一切都是我的錯。
謝謝你的幫助，
請保重。

scripts.text:
[Erious]
*Cries* Is there no way that I
can see her again? If I could
talk to her at least once more,
even if it's the last time,
I would do anything...
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
*哭泣* 難道真的沒有辦法再見到她了嗎？
如果能再和她說話一次，
哪怕只是最後一次，
我願意付出任何代價...

scripts.text:
[Erious]
*Cries* Eeeeelllllyyyy~~~~!
I never thought that would be
the last time we would see
each other...
*Sob*...
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
*哭泣* 艾...莉...~~~~!
我沒想到那會是
我們最後一次見面...
*抽泣*...

scripts.text:
[Erious]
This place I was told about...
The town of the dead...
From what I remember, it was
located near some rest area.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
我聽說的那個地方...
亡者之鎮...
據我回憶，它位於某個休息區附近。

scripts.text:
[Erious]
All day and night, it's filled
with never ending screams of
agony and despair. I hope that
this will be helpful in your search.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
那裡日夜不停地充斥著
痛苦與絕望的無盡哀嚎。
希望這能對你的尋找有所幫助。

scripts.text:
[Erious]
Oh my! You really found the town,
have you? I really appreciate that
you've endured all this hardship
for me... Um...So in the end...
Were you able to meet my Elly?
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
天哪！你真的找到那個城鎮了嗎？
非常感謝你為我忍受了這些艱辛...
嗯...那麼最後...
你見到我的艾莉了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: Sorry, I couldn't.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我沒有見到她。

scripts.text:
[Erious]
Are you serious? What did she say?
Did she say she will forgive me?
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
你是認真的嗎？她說了什麼？
她說她會原諒我嗎？

scripts.text: Yes. And she gave me...this.
scripts.translation: 是的。而且她給了我...這個。

scripts.text:
[Erious]
Ah...In this box were the gifts
I gave her when we started
seeing each other. She had a
serious illness even before we
met, so I promised her that I
would cure her illness...
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
啊...這個盒子裡裝的是
我們剛開始交往時我送給她的禮物。
我們在相遇前她就患有重病，
所以我曾向她承諾，
我會治好她的病...

scripts.text:
[Erious]
That's why I went on that trip...
to find a cure or medicine
for her... But my efforts turned
out to be a good for nothing.
...................
.........
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
所以我才去那趟旅行...
為了尋找治癒她的藥方或藥物...
但我的努力最終都白費了。
...................
.........

scripts.text:
[Erious]
Anyway, I appreciate your
generousity. I want to pay
you back for all the trouble
I caused you, but I only have
the medicine I found for her
illness during this trip.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
總之，非常感謝你的慷慨。
我想報答你為我造成的麻煩，
但我只有這次旅途中
為她找到的那些藥。

scripts.text:
[Erious]
I hope you will take this medicine
as a token of my gratitute.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
希望你能收下這些藥，
作為我的一點心意。

scripts.text:
[Erious]
Thank you for everything.
I wish you luck and safety
in your adventures.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
謝謝你所做的一切。
祝你在冒險中好運平安。

scripts.text:
[Erious]
I have something to give you,
but you're carrying too much
stuff for me to give it to
right now. Why don't you
store your items somewhere?
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
我有東西要給你，
但你身上帶的東西太多了，
我現在沒法給你。你為什麼不
先把物品存到某個地方呢？

scripts.text:
[Erious]
Hmm...this is odd. I'm sure she would give you something as a token of meeting her. By any chance, is there anything that you've forgetten to bring me?
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
嗯...這很奇怪。我確信她會見你時
會給你一些東西作為紀念。你該不會
有什麼東西忘記帶給我了吧？

scripts.text:
[Erious]
I guess you misunderstood
something or you're trying
to scam a man in grief.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
看來是你誤會了什麼，
或者你是在試圖欺騙一個悲傷的人。

scripts.text:
[Erious]
I see...you have failed to find
her... However, I also understand
that fulfilling my request may
be impossible...
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
我明白了...你沒能找到她...
不過，我也理解
完成我的請求可能是不可能的...

scripts.text:
[Erious]
You've really gone out of your way
to help me, so I want to give you
something as a token of my
gratitute.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
你真的費心幫我了，
所以我想給你一些東西
作為我的一點心意。

scripts.text:
[Erious]
Thank you for everything.
I wish you luck and safety
from harm in your journeys.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
感謝你所做的一切。
願你在旅途中幸運平安，
遠離一切傷害。

scripts.text:
[Erious]
I have something to give you,
but you're carrying too much
stuff for me to give it to
right now. Why don't you
store your items somewhere?
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
我有東西要給你，
但你身上帶的東西太多了，
我現在沒法給你。你為什麼不
先把物品存到某個地方呢？

scripts.text:
[Erious]
I see...
...Wait! Doesn't that belong
to my wife, Elly? Why are you
trying to cheat a grieving man...?
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
我明白了...
...等等！那東西
難道是我妻子艾莉的嗎？
你為什麼要欺騙一個
沉浸在悲痛中的人...

scripts.text:
[Billik]
Well, long time no see.
If you have a chance in the
future, let's meet in the
town of the dead later.
Hahahaha~
scripts.translation:
[比利克]
哎呀，好久不見了。
如果將來有機會，
我們再到亡者之鎮見面吧。
哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Billik]
The Town of the dead...
It's a very dangerous place.
Why would you want to go there?
scripts.translation:
[比利克]
亡者之鎮...
那是個非常危險的地方。
你為什麼想去那裡？

scripts.text: I have to meet somebody there.
scripts.translation: 我必須去那裡見一個人。

scripts.text: It's a part of my adventure.
scripts.translation: 這是我冒險的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Billik]
Someone you have to meet there...
Hmm... I suppose you wish to
contact the dead...
I can also see that you're
determined to go.
scripts.translation:
[比利克]
必須去那裡見的人...
嗯...我想你是想
與死者聯絡吧...
我也看得出你
去意已決。

scripts.text:
[Billik]
*Sigh* Okay, if you really want to
go, you must find a man named
'Feylin.' It's very important to
let him know that I introduced
him to you.
scripts.translation:
[比利克]
*嘆氣* 好吧，如果你真的
非去不可，你必須去找
一個叫“費琳”的人。
一定要讓他知道
是我介紹你去的。

scripts.text:
[Billik]
He's not very trusting, but he
likes roses a lot, so bring a rose
for him. That way, he'll know for
sure that I've sent you.
scripts.translation:
[比利克]
他不太容易相信別人，
但他非常喜歡玫瑰，
所以給他帶一朵玫瑰吧。
這樣他就能確定
是我派你來的。

scripts.text:
[Billik]
The town of the dead is located
north of this place. Remember, it
is very dangerous to go there,
even for well experienced
adventurers, so...
Be careful.
scripts.translation:
[比利克]
亡者之鎮位於
這個地方的北方。
記住，去那裡非常危險，
即使是經驗豐富的
冒險者也...
請小心。

scripts.text:
[Billik]
Hahaha~ I guess you like adventure
as much as I do. Although it's a
very dangrous place, you will be
paid back for your effort after
you get there. But be careful.
scripts.translation:
[比利克]
哈哈哈~看來你和我一樣
喜歡冒險。雖然那裡
非常危險，但等你到達後，
你的付出會得到回報的。
不過要小心。

scripts.text:
[Billik]
What brings you here? I'm busy,
leave if you don't have any business.
scripts.translation:
[比利克]
你來這裡做什麼？我很忙，
如果沒有正事就請離開。

scripts.text:
[Feylin]
Poor {0}...
Dying at such a young age...
I am always sorry to see the
young pass away.
scripts.translation:
[費琳]
可憐的{0}...
年紀輕輕就...
看到年輕人離世，
我總是感到難過。

scripts.text:
[Feylin]
............??
Oh, I see you're not dead yet,
are you? It's unbelievable to
see another living person
in this town.
scripts.translation:
[費琳]
............??
哦，看來你還沒死，
是嗎？在這個城鎮裡
看到另一個活人，
真是難以置信。

scripts.text:
[Feylin]
Are you coming to rescue someone,
or do you have another purpose?
If you came here to meet a
deceased friend of yours, you've
come to the wrong person.
scripts.translation:
[費琳]
你是來救人的，
還是有其他目的？
如果你來這裡是為了
見一位已故的朋友，
那你找錯人了。

scripts.text:
[Feylin]
Nobody in Niflheim can
perform that kind of miracle...
scripts.translation:
[費琳]
尼弗海姆的任何人
都無法做到那種奇蹟...

scripts.text:
[Feylin]
I can tell you have been through
much hardship, but unfortunately,
you came here for nothing. I hope
you go back to where you came
from before it's too late.
scripts.translation:
[費琳]
我能看出你經歷了許多
苦難，但很遺憾，
你此行一無所獲。我希望
你在為時已晚之前
回到你來的地方。

scripts.text:
[Feylin]
I've asked you to leave this
town immediately. I'm sorry
but I know nothing about what
you are asking.
scripts.translation:
[費琳]
我已經要求你立即
離開這個城鎮。抱歉，
我對你所問的事情
一無所知。

scripts.text: But...
scripts.translation: 但是...

scripts.text: I am sorry.
scripts.translation: 對不起。

scripts.text:
[Feylin]
You must know something...
Otherwise, you wouldn't be
so stubborn. I am not sure
who told you contacting the
dead might be possible...
scripts.translation:
[費琳]
你一定知道些什麼...
否則你不會這麼固執。
我不確定是誰告訴你
可以與死者聯絡...

scripts.text:
[Feylin]
But I surely wouldn't have told
you. Besides, speaking about
such things is taboo.
scripts.translation:
[費琳]
但我絕對沒有告訴過你。
況且，談論這些事情是禁忌。

scripts.text:
[Feylin]
Please consider leaving this
place as soon as possible.
Nobody should stay in
Niflheim for too long.
scripts.translation:
[費琳]
請考慮儘快離開這裡。
沒有人應該在尼弗爾海姆停留太久。

scripts.text:
[Feylin]
Huh, Billik must have sent you.
Since I'm indebted to him, I
suppose I will help you.
But let me warn you.
The price that I demand may be
more that you expect...
scripts.translation:
[費琳]
啊，原來是比利克派你來的。
既然我欠他人情，我想我可以幫你。
但我必須警告你。
我要求的代價可能比你預期的要多...

scripts.text: I'm willing to do this.
scripts.translation: 我願意接受。

scripts.text: I don't think I can do this.
scripts.translation: 我想我做不到。

scripts.text:
[Feylin]
Alright, but you must promise
me that you will not let other
people know what I am about
to tell you.
scripts.translation:
[費琳]
好吧，但你必須向我保證，
不會讓其他人知道
我即將告訴你的事情。

scripts.text:
[Feylin]
This sorcery requires great
sacrifice. Needless to say, there
is a chance that this spell may
fail. I must also have
10 Yggdrasil Leaf to cast this
spell. Do you wish to continue?
scripts.translation:
[費琳]
這種巫術需要巨大的犧牲。
不用說，這個咒語可能會失敗。
我也需要10片天地樹葉子才能施法。
你確定要繼續嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Feylin]
I see. Then we shall begin.
Woombahsokasabahah!
Woombah woombah hoombabah!
Yeeeeep!
scripts.translation:
[費琳]
我明白了。那麼我們要開始了。
Woombahsokasabahah!
Woombah woombah hoombabah!
Yeeeeep!

scripts.text:
[Feylin]
...I am sorry.
I have failed to summon
who you wish to see. I am
really sorry for this result.
scripts.translation:
[費琳]
...我很抱歉。
我沒能召喚出你想見的人。
對於這個結果，我真的非常抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Feylin]
Unfortunately, it may be
impossible to summon the
spirit of the person with
whom you wished to speak...
scripts.translation:
[費琳]
不幸的是，可能無法召喚
你想與之對話的那個人的靈魂...

scripts.text:
[Elly]
..........
.....Umm...
...Wasn't I just dead?
Um, do I know you?
I brought a message from your husband.
scripts.translation: 我帶來了你丈夫的留言。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Oh...I see...I'm sorry that I could not meet him before I died...
So what is his message for me?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
哦...我明白了...很遺憾我在死前沒能見到他...
那麼，他給我留了什麼話？

scripts.text: Forgive him for what happened a month ago.
scripts.translation: 請原諒他一個月前所做的事。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
*Sigh* He's such a nice husband...
He pays such attention, even to
the little things. Though, I
should be the one apologizing
to him...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
*嘆氣* 他是個很好的丈夫...
他對小事都很細心。不過，
應該是我向他道歉才對...

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Please give him this box, and tell
him to forget about me. He should
live the rest of his life happily
with someone else. Oh, also let
him know that I forgive him.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
請把這個盒子交給他，並告訴他
忘掉我。他應該和另一個人
幸福地度過餘生。哦，也讓他知道
我原諒他了。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
I am glad to hear from my
husband one more time. But I
think I have to go now.
Thank you for your trouble.
Farewell...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
很高興能再次收到我丈夫的訊息。但我
我想我該走了。
謝謝你的麻煩。
再見...

scripts.text:
[Feylin]
I guess you have accomplished what
you wanted. Well then, be careful
when you go back...
scripts.translation:
[費琳]
我想你已經完成了你想做的事。
那麼，回去的時候小心點...

scripts.text:
[Feylin]
If you don't have the
items, we cannot proceed.
Remember, I need 10 Yggdrasil
Leaves to perform this spell.
Please bring them as soon
as possible.
scripts.translation:
[費琳]
如果你沒有那些物品，我們無法繼續。
記住，我需要10片世界樹的葉子才能施展這個法術。
請儘快把它們帶過來。

scripts.text:
[Feylin]
I hope you will bring the items
first. But... I don't have the
confidence to promise that
this spell will cast successfully.
scripts.translation:
[費琳]
我希望你能先帶來那些物品。但是...我沒有信心保證這個法術一定能成功施展。

scripts.text:
[Feylin]
Hmm... You don't seem to have
the strength to endure the
casting of this spell. At
your current strength, this
spell will kill you.
I cannot take that risk.
scripts.translation:
[費琳]
嗯...你似乎沒有足夠的力量來承受這個法術的施放。
以你現在的力量，這個法術會要了你的命。
我不能冒這個險。

scripts.text:
[Feylin]
You made a good decision.
It's not a good idea to perform
this kind of sorcery in the
first place because of the
risks involved...
scripts.translation:
[費琳]
你做了一個正確的決定。
首先，因為風險太大，本來就不應該施展這種巫術...

scripts.text:
[Feylin]
No matter how many times you ask
me, I cannot help you. Please
leave this place as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[費琳]
不管你問多少次，我都幫不了你。請立刻離開這裡。

scripts.text:
[Feylin]
What makes you to come to such
a dangerous town? Please leave
this place as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[費琳]
是什麼讓你來到這麼危險的城鎮？請立刻離開這裡。
